name: braintrain
description: The brain fine-tuning pipeline, conversational: how many training examples are logged, export the curated dataset (secrets redacted, deduped, balanced), run a QLoRA train job, evaluate a candidate against the regression gate, promote or roll back adapters. route: brain training status, how many training examples, export training data, fine-tune your brain, evaluate the fine-tune, roll back the adapter
